title: Example Datasets in r4subdata

title: Example Datasets in r4subdata
text: second therapeutic-area bundle represents synthetic CNS (neuroscience) submission (study CNS-2025-001, modelled Phase II Alzheimer’s disease trial) ADSL, ADQS, ADTTE datasets. object mirrors column/type contract oncology counterpart exactly, downstream functions work unchanged: cns_metadata, cns_evidence, sdtm_metadata_cns, trace_mapping_cns, risk_register_cns. CNS traceability mapping references ADaM variables present cns_metadata SDTM variables present sdtm_metadata_cns, round-trips r4subtrace::build_trace_model() cleanly.

title: r4subdata: Example Datasets for R4SUB
text: validate_dataset() structural, non-inventive helper: checks column names types dataset_dictionary() (custom dictionary), reporting missing columns, unexpected columns, type mismatches, optional column-order differences. imposes regulatory values thresholds.
code: library(r4subdata)  # Explore available datasets list_datasets()  # Load and inspect data(evidence_pharma) table(evidence_pharma$indicator_domain)  # Column dictionary dataset_dictionary("evidence_pharma")  # Validate a data frame against a dataset's schema (columns + types) validate_dataset(adam_metadata, "adam_metadata")   # 0 issues = conforms

title: r4subdata: Example Datasets for R4SUB
code: library(r4subcore) library(r4subscore) library(r4subdata)  # Score the pharma evidence scores  <- compute_indicator_scores(evidence_pharma) pillars <- compute_pillar_scores(evidence_pharma) sci     <- compute_sci(pillars)  # Traceability library(r4subtrace) model <- build_trace_model(adam_metadata, sdtm_metadata, trace_mapping)  # Risk analysis library(r4subrisk) rr <- create_risk_register(risk_register_pharma)  # Oncology study scores_onco <- compute_indicator_scores(oncology_evidence)  # CNS (neuroscience) study scores_cns  <- compute_indicator_scores(cns_evidence) model_cns   <- build_trace_model(cns_metadata, sdtm_metadata_cns, trace_mapping_cns)

title: r4subdata: Example Datasets for Clinical Submission Readiness — r4subdata-package
text: Provides realistic synthetic example datasets R4SUB (Ready Submission) ecosystem. Includes pharma study evidence table, ADaM (Analysis Data Model) SDTM (Study Data Tabulation Model) metadata following CDISC (Clinical Data Interchange Standards Consortium) conventions (https://www.cdisc.org), traceability mappings, risk register based ICH (International Council Harmonisation) Q9 quality risk management principles (https://www.ich.org/page/quality-guidelines), regulatory indicator definitions. Designed demos, vignettes, package testing.

text: Failure Mode Effects Analysis (FMEA)-based risk register synthetic CNS study CNS-2025-001 (study described cns_metadata cns_evidence). title: r4subdata (development version)
text: Added second synthetic therapeutic-area example bundle CNS (neuroscience) study CNS-2025-001, modelled Phase II Alzheimer’s disease trial, users can demo full ecosystem second study: cns_metadata (ADaM metadata ADSL, ADQS, ADTTE), cns_evidence (29-row evidence table across four pillars), risk_register_cns (15-row FMEA register), sdtm_metadata_cns (SDTM metadata DM, QS, SC), trace_mapping_cns (ADaM--SDTM mapping). object mirrors column/type contract oncology counterpart exactly; bundle internally consistent (IDs line across trace mapping) round-trips r4subtrace::build_trace_model(). values synthetic regulatory reference values invented. datasets documented, covered dataset_dictionary(), listed list_datasets() (group "cns"), guarded schema-contract per-dataset tests. list_datasets() group column now also tags datasets "cns" (CNS-2025-001). Added validate_dataset(): structural schema-validation helper checks data frame column/type schema shipped dataset (defined dataset_dictionary()) custom dictionary shape. reports missing columns, unexpected columns, type mismatches, (strict mode) column-order differences, carries logical valid attribute. invents regulatory values, thresholds, code lists. Added sdtm_metadata_oncology trace_mapping_oncology: synthetic SDTM metadata (DM, RS, TU) ADaM--SDTM traceability mapping oncology study ONCO-2025-001. mirror schemas sdtm_metadata trace_mapping, internally consistent oncology_metadata, round-trip r4subtrace::build_trace_model(). documented, covered dataset_dictionary(), listed list_datasets() (group "oncology"), guarded schema-contract test. Added risk_register_oncology: 15-row FMEA risk register synthetic oncology study ONCO-2025-001, mirroring schema risk_register_pharma. documented, covered dataset_dictionary(), listed list_datasets(). list_datasets() now includes group column tagging dataset "pharma" "oncology". Added schema-contract test asserting every documented dataset’s row/column counts column types match shipped data. dataset_dictionary() now returns column dictionaries oncology_metadata oncology_evidence; previously two datasets (exported listed list_datasets()) raised “Unknown dataset” error. Fixed stale “R Regulatory Submission” expansions “R4SUB” dataset documentation vignette match DESCRIPTION (“Ready Submission”). Corrected ADaM/SDTM variable counts shown list_datasets() (36 43, matching actual datasets).
